title: aceitunaoil.com — Multilingual Olive Oil Website
intro: A sleek, multilingual one-page website to showcase premium olive oil products.
summary: Built with WordPress and Avada, customized with CSS, and deployed on a VPS (WHM/cPanel). Supports English, Turkish, and Arabic with responsive presentation.
features: Single-page layout highlighting products and brand
Custom CSS refinements for polished visuals
VPS hosting with WHM/cPanel for stability

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A multilingual landing experience focused on clarity, speed, and product presentation.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Reach international audiences and present products professionally with minimal maintenance overhead.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Led theme customization, CSS refinement, language toggling, and VPS deployment.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Expanded accessibility and delivered a maintainable, brand-aligned presence.
